message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge(s) for the case.

Facts: Defendant Deng (邓某某) from 2012-2013 sold non-drug items masquerading as drugs, i.e., fake medicines. The items: “痹痛舒康冬虫草全蝎胶囊”, “冬虫草蝮蛇胶囊”, “特效颈椎疼痛宁胶囊” are non-drugs pretending to be drugs, should be considered counterfeit drugs (假药). Also “左炔诺孕酮片”（“毓某”） is also counterfeit drug. So the charge is "生产、销售假药". The list includes "生产、销售假药". That matches.

Any other charges? He allowed sales, profit. No other crimes like fraud? It's selling counterfeit drugs, which is a specific offense. So single charge.

Thus answer: [罪名]生产、销售假药<eoa>
